blocks.value: Revenue is the total amount of money a company earns by selling its products or services before deducting any expenses.
Imagine This: Your restaurant serves 200 meals in a day at ₹300 each. Your total sales for the day are ₹60,000. That is your revenue.
Revenue tells us how much business a company is doing, but it does not tell us whether the company is making a profit.
Two companies may both earn ₹1,000 crore in revenue, but one may be profitable while the other may be losing money.
Revenue is often called the 'Top Line' because it appears at the top of the Profit & Loss Statement.
